name: [⚾] Steal a Baseball Player
desc:
⚾ Steal a Baseball Player 🧢
The brand-new baseball twist on the steal-and-collect genre!
Discord: https://discord.gg/nuZ6Rf59sY

🔥Like the Game and join the Group for Free Players!

[How to Play]
• Buy Baseball Players from running the bases
• Add them to your collection to generate Money
• Obtain special mutations and traits on your Baseball Players
• Steal rare Baseball Players and dominate the leaderboard!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile, Tablet and Console players

Game made by @clawlift, @worlock1024, @vqiume
